bibliographic.title: The Christmas Dragon's Quest
bibliographic.author: Lamp Post Projects
bibliographic.description:
Santa Claus needs your help! Wynterwyrm the dragon, the guardian of Christmas magic, has been captured by a malevolent sorcerer on a mission to seize control of the North Pole. Break into his ice palace, rescue the dragon, and save Christmas.

A choice-based interactive fiction game that blends light-hearted holiday spirit with high fantasy adventure.

• Play solo, or gather family and friends to play as up to three custom characters (with chances for each to take the lead during gameplay!).

• Tackle Christmas-themed puzzles that range from easy to difficult.
